extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from main text, Fig. 4 caption, Methods, Supplementary Figures 13-15, and Supplementary Notes. Mechanism is bounded: LPS/outer-membrane association and bactericidal phenotypes are supported; intracellular targets remain unresolved by source.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Brevicidine and laterocidine activity is inhibited by exogenous LPS or high Mg2+ in Table 1, and brevicidine has source-reported LPS binding by ITC; this supports LPS/outer-membrane association.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Brevicidine and laterocidine; ITC quantified directly for brevicidine and polymyxin B comparator.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source quantifies Kd for brevicidine only; laterocidine LPS association is inferred from shared activity pattern and authors' interpretation, not a separate ITC value.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill, growth kinetics, lysis, and AFM show bactericidal and morphology-disrupting effects on E. coli/P. aeruginosa, but the paper states the compounds may not act by generic polymyxin-like membrane lysis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is bounded to membrane-associated phenotypes; intracellular targets are explicitly not characterized in the local source.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source explicitly says more in-depth mechanism study is needed for intracellular targets and membrane disruption effects; do not promote protein synthesis or translation pathway mentions to a direct mechanism for this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No source-supported direct protein synthesis/translation-target mechanism was recovered from local material.
